summary: Engine speed 2: ValidateAbility now returns its refusal as a string (ValidateAbilityResult) instead of throwing; ValidateAbility wraps it for every command path, TryValidateAbility serves the action listing. 197 checks converted by a one-off Roslyn rewrite; slot-candidate, performer and Favor-discard checks too. RuleViolation throws per decision 120 to 2.3; about 6% less wall time on 20 bot matches.
validation: check.sh --skip-client passes; differential hash of every action list (options, reasons, quotes) identical to main over 11,213 and 13,270 decisions (seeds 1.. and 2000..); interleaved A/B vs main, three rounds; TirelessHomeTests source scan updated for the new shape.
remaining: Hook-based throws (RegisteredValidateEarly, ValidateWielderCosts, RequireLegalAttackTarget) still throw, about 2 per decision.
